metadata.name: OpenClaw
metadata.summary: A personal AI assistant that connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord and more.

zh-CN.summary: OpenClaw 不用 root 权限运行，根文件系统只读，应用最严格的 Kubernetes Pod 安全设置，也没有 Kubernetes 令牌。对外连接一律走 HTTPS。向外的网络流量没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: OpenClaw 不用 root 權限執行，根檔案系統唯讀，套用最嚴格的 Kubernetes Pod 安全設定，也沒有 Kubernetes 權杖。對外連線一律走 HTTPS。往外的網路流量沒有限制。

zh-CN.mitigation: 每个命名空间和网关只给一位可信任的所有者使用。Pod 没有挂载主机目录，没有服务账号令牌，也没有 Docker socket，资源也有上限。不要分享给你不信任的人。
zh-CN.risk: AI 助理可以执行命令，也能读到它的 Pod 碰得到的所有东西，包括状态数据和模型的凭证。Pod 的安全设置挡不住提示注入，也就是有人用恶意消息骗助理去做事。

zh-TW.mitigation: 每個命名空間和閘道只給一位可信任的擁有者使用。Pod 沒有掛載主機目錄，沒有服務帳號權杖，也沒有 Docker socket，資源也有上限。不要分享給你不信任的人。
zh-TW.risk: AI 助理可以執行指令，也能讀到它的 Pod 碰得到的所有東西，包括狀態資料和模型的認證資訊。Pod 的安全設定擋不住提示注入，也就是有人用惡意訊息騙助理去做事。

risks.mitigation: Use one trusted owner per namespace and gateway. The pod has no host mounts, no service-account token and no Docker socket, and its resources are limited. Do not share it with users you do not trust.
risks.risk: The AI assistant can run commands and read everything its pod can reach, including its state and model credentials. Pod security settings do not stop prompt injection, where a hostile message tricks the assistant into acting.

zh-CN.mitigation: 先停止写入，再把整个 PVC、网关机密和供应商机密做加密备份，存到集群外面。节点本地的 StorageClass 没有高可用，也不能做卷快照。
zh-CN.risk: 代理程序的状态和频道凭证都放在同一个 PVC（一个数据卷）里。

zh-TW.mitigation: 先停止寫入，再把整個 PVC、閘道機密和供應商機密做加密備份，存到叢集外面。節點本機的 StorageClass 沒有高可用，也不能做磁碟區快照。
zh-TW.risk: 代理程式的狀態和頻道認證資訊都放在同一個 PVC（一個資料磁碟區）裡。

risks.mitigation: Stop writes, then make encrypted backups outside the cluster of the whole PVC, the gateway Secret and the provider Secret. A node-local StorageClass has no high availability and no volume snapshots.
risks.risk: The agent's state and channel credentials are stored together on one PVC (one data volume).

security.summary: OpenClaw runs without root rights, with a read-only root filesystem, the strictest Kubernetes pod security profile and no Kubernetes token. Traffic comes in over HTTPS. Outbound traffic is not limited.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: openclaw-bootstrap
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-bootstrap
data:
  bootstrap.cjs: "const fs = require('node:fs');\nconst p = '/home/node/.openclaw/openclaw.json';\nfs.mkdirSync('/home/node/.openclaw',\
    \ { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });\nif (!fs.existsSync(p)) {\n  const c = {\n    gateway: { mode: 'local', bind: 'lan',\
    \ auth: { mode: 'token', token: '${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN}' }, controlUi: { allowedOrigins: ['https://' + process.env.PUBLIC_DOMAIN]\
    \ } },\n    models: { providers: { custom: { baseUrl: process.env.LLM_BASE_URL, apiKey: '${LLM_API_KEY}', api: 'openai-completions',\
    \ models: [{ id: process.env.LLM_MODEL, name: process.env.LLM_MODEL, input: ['text', 'image'], contextWindow: 128000,\
    \ maxTokens: 8192 }] } } },\n    agents: { defaults: { model: { primary: 'custom/' + process.env.LLM_MODEL }, workspace:\
    \ '/home/node/.openclaw/workspace' } }\n  };\n  fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(c, null, 2), { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx'\
    \ });\n}\n"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: openclaw-home
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw-home
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: openclaw
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: openclaw
        app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw
        templates.zeabur.com/openclaw-browser-sandbox-client: 'true'
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: openclaw
        image: ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.10.7@sha256:fb26f0841659dc757f23feec9adeab51f11d76779a409db5d22e191b43841afa
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 18789
        env:
        - name: HOME
          value: /home/node
        - name: PUBLIC_DOMAIN
          value: '{{ .Domain }}'
        - name: LLM_BASE_URL
          value: '{{ .Inputs.llmBaseUrl }}'
        - name: LLM_MODEL
          value: '{{ .Inputs.llmModel }}'
        - name: OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BONJOUR
          value: '1'
        - name: NODE_OPTIONS
          value: --max-old-space-size=2048
        - name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: openclaw-secrets
              key: gateway-token
        - name: LLM_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: '{{ .Inputs.providerSecret }}'
              key: api-key
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 1Gi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 4Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: home
          mountPath: /home/node
        - name: bootstrap
          mountPath: /bootstrap
          readOnly: true
        command:
        - /usr/bin/tini
        - -s
        - --
        - /bin/sh
        - -ec
        args:
        - node /bootstrap/bootstrap.cjs; exec node /app/openclaw.mjs gateway --bind lan
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /startupz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /startupz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 60
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
      - name: home
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: openclaw-home
      - name: bootstrap
        configMap:
          name: openclaw-bootstrap
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: openclaw
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18789
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: openclaw
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: openclaw
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.entrypoints: websecure
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: openclaw-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: openclaw
            port:
              name: http
